label.zh: 每项无限课题的随机结果
label.en: One random outcome per Infinity Thesis

note.zh: 每完成一级可重复的“无限课题”抽取一次；带全局效果的结果在整个银河只出现一次，并通知所有帝国。
note.en: Each level of the repeatable Infinity Thesis rolls once; outcomes with galaxy-wide effects happen once per galaxy and notify every empire.

label.zh: 登船：殖民地或方舟
label.en: Embarking: colonies or arkships

note.zh: 普通帝国由刺针逐一造访殖民地；游牧帝国则造访方舟船队。
note.en: Ordinary empires have the Needle visit each colony; nomadic empires have it visit their arkship fleets.

label.zh: 穿越黑洞：两种视角
label.en: The crossing: two points of view

note.zh: 宇宙创生帝国15天后读到“无穷的彼岸”并获胜；其他帝国1天后读到“穿透奇点”。
note.en: The Cosmogenesis empire reads The Yonder Side of Infinity after 15 days and wins; every other empire reads Piercing a Singularity after 1 day.

label.zh: 胜利：穿越至无穷的彼岸
label.en: Victory: beyond the event horizon

note.zh: 宇宙创生帝国赢得游戏，成为堕落帝国；正文按穿越的黑洞与帝国情况变化。其他帝国随后收到“时间扭曲”。
note.en: The Cosmogenesis empire wins the game and becomes a Fallen Empire; the text varies with the black hole and the empire. Other empires then receive Time Warp.

crisis.7516.evidence: events/machine_age_crisis_events.txt:3148-3432 crisis.7516 after: make_fallen_empire, win = yes, crisis.7518 to default empires after 5 days

label.zh: 可能的中止：接受最后通牒
label.en: Possible abort: accept the ultimatum

note.zh: 第一个选项会中止计划并摧毁己方突触凝练机，此后无法达到第四、五级；道歉或拒绝（宣战）则计划继续。
note.en: The first option aborts the plan and destroys your Synaptic Lathes, so levels 4 and 5 can no longer be reached; apologising or refusing (war) lets the plan continue.

crisis.7285.evidence: events/machine_age_crisis_events.txt:2620-2655 option a sets cosmogenesis_aborted; 00_crisis_levels.txt:463-466, 508-511 levels 4/5 require NOT cosmogenesis_aborted

notes.zh: 到达第三级7天后，若存在狂热唯物堕落帝国，会收到其警告（仅一次）；两个回答都不会中止计划。
notes.en: Seven days after level 3, a fanatic materialist Fallen Empire (if any) sends a warning (once); neither reply stops the project.

notes.zh: 到达第五级时，所有未与你交战的堕落帝国对你宣战（00_crisis_levels / crisis.7120 after）。
notes.en: On reaching level 5, every Fallen Empire not already at war with you declares war (crisis.7120 after).

scope.zh: 完整核对 machine_age_crisis_events.txt 的宇宙创生部分（7100–7545）、五个天灾等级的条件与 on_unlock、等级科技、无限课题随机表、视界刺针与结局。
scope.en: Checked the Cosmogenesis section of machine_age_crisis_events.txt (7100–7545), the five crisis levels' requirements and on_unlock, level technologies, the Infinity Thesis table, the Horizon Needle and the ending.

uncertain: Level thresholds are crisis-currency (Advanced Logic) amounts from the level definitions; objective income rates were not modelled.
Synaptic Lathe events (7530/7535/7540) are optional side events available from level 1 (tech_cosmogenesis_world); 7530/7535 are mostly seen by other empires.
